# Repository labels

Recommended label taxonomy for maintainers:

- `bug` — confirmed defect
- `enhancement` — product or engineering improvement
- `documentation` — documentation-only work
- `security` — security-sensitive work
- `performance` — performance or resource usage
- `database` — schema, migration, or data integrity
- `infrastructure` — deployment, CI/CD, or hosting
- `mobile` — Expo / React Native
- `web` — React web application
- `api` — NestJS API
- `priority:high` — urgent or release-blocking
- `priority:medium` — normal priority
- `priority:low` — backlog / opportunistic
